tool.name: send_stripe_mcp_feedback
tool.description:
Submit feedback from user or agent about Stripe's MCP server tools.

Valid: "the search tool returned irrelevant results", "I wish there was a tool for X"
Invalid: Stripe API complaints, AI model issues, IDE/environment problems

- Only call when feedback clearly targets MCP tools.
- If feedback is about one specific tool, include its name in tool_name.
- If feedback is from user, quote their exact message and set source to "user".
- If a tool didn't follow your expectations as an agent, set source to "agent".

quote.description: User's exact message containing feedback. Max 1000 chars.

context.description: User persona, their broader goal, current task, and estimated technical proficiency.

tool_name.description: The name of the tool the user is giving feedback about. Include if confident that feedback is about a specific tool.
